criteria.description: Must reference WCAG 2.1 AA or AAA compliance levels
Must check color contrast ratios (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text)
Must verify keyboard navigation and focus management
Must check ARIA labels, roles, and screen reader compatibility
Must address prefers-reduced-motion and animation concerns

testPrompt: Audit this component for accessibility: A dark-themed dashboard card grid with clickable client cards, a search input, status filter buttons, and a dropdown selector. All on a #0A0A0F background.
